notes.title: Patch Notes - Unlocks, Food and Weapon enchantments
notes.content:
[h2]Unlocks[/h2]
Most items and weapons need to be unlocked to appear inside the armory or shop.
After each run you get a chance to unlock a new item, defeat more bosses to increase the unlock chance.

[h2]Food[/h2]
Enemies and Treasure chests will sometimes drop food to regenerate some health.
But be careful if you get hit the regeneration will be canceled.

[h2]Weapon Enchantments[/h2]
In addition to the old weapon upgrades, weapons now might be upgraded with powerful on hit effects:

[b]Burn[/b]
Occasionally sets the target on fire, dealing bonus damage over time.

[b]Cold[/b]
Slows the target.

[b]Freeze[/b]
Will rarely freeze the target for up to 10 seconds. Damage will break the frozen state.

[b]Lifesteal[/b]
Adds some bonus damage and will steal some health from the target with every hit.

[b]Lightning[/b]
Will rarely stun the target and deal a larger ammount of bonus damage.

[b]Poison[/b]
Adds some damage over time to most hits.

[h2]Development Branch[/h2]
The testing branch is now open to everybody and can be accessed via Game beta settings

[h2]Bug Fixes and changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items are no longer stored in bags
[*] Playerghosts will regenerate mana faster when not inside a player
[*] Stronger health potions have been added
[*] Regeneration potion has been added (and a stronger version aswell)
[*] Gold now makes sounds when picked up
[*] Consumable display has been modified to give a better overview over item fill level
[*] Small performance improvements
[*] Various smaller fixes
[/list]

Patch Version 0.1.2

notes.title: Patch Notes - New Bosses and Treasure Chests
notes.content:
[h2]Treasure Chest[/h2]
A locked treasure chest has been added with a random chance to spawn in each level.
To unlock it you just have to kill all enemies inside the level. Each chest contains a larger amount of gold and has a chance to drop potions and items (sometimes even upgraded weapons). Additionally every boss level has a chest with special boss loot.

[h2]Two new bosses have been added to the Game:[/h2]
[b]Ninjas[/b]
Three hidden Ninjas spawn around the boss chest. They are armed with Ninja Stars and will attack you on sight. They are able to switch their weapons to two-handed swords.

[b]Golemancer[/b]
A single Golemancer will spawn with some inactive golems around him. The boss will move to any of the golems and activate it for a limited amount of time. Each time these golems are hit, their energy will decrease until they go inactive again. Kill the Golemancer and all golems will eventually run out of energy.

[h2]Loot[/h2]
All enemies now have a chance to spawn potions and items on death. Different types of enemies have different loot tables.

[h2]Throwing Weapons overhaul[/h2]
Ninja Stars were added to the game. Throwing weapons on the ground can be picked up to refill the players ammunition.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spawn rate of keystones has been adjusted
[*] Item descriptions should no longer move out of view
[*] Throwing weapons are now refilled when the level is changed (Kunai, Throwing Spears, Ninja Stars)
[*] The shield indicator should now be deactivated if the player dies 
[*] Various smaller UI changes and fixes
[/list]

Patch Version 0.1.1
